name: National Vulnerability Database (NVD)
description: NIST-operated database that enriches CVE records with CVSS scores, CWE categorizations, and configuration mappings. Industry standard for vulnerability prioritization.

peerReview.processDescription: NIST analysts enrich CVE records with CVSS scores, CWE categorizations, and configuration mappings. Standardized scoring (CVSS v3.1/v4.0) through structured review. Automated checks plus human analyst review.

attribution.attributionNotes: Indirect recognition. NVD validates severity and impact of vulnerabilities. CVSS scores are the industry standard for prioritization. No direct researcher recognition.

povsAlignment.description: Vulnerability database that validates severity and impact through CVSS scoring.
